title: 3.0.0.1 - Hypo TT replaces Active TT
symptom: When a temp target such as Activity is active, a hypo temp target replaces it, and after the hypo TT expires, the original temp target is not restored; instead the default profile target is used.
cause: The behavior is expected per maintainer MilosKozak, but the thread discusses that the system changes the temp target without user noticing, and there is no mechanism to restore the previous temp target.
